pages.text: Mystcraft includes several admin-facing commands under $(thing)/mystcraft$(). The most important are $(li)/mystcraft time set ...$(li)/mystcraft weather ...$(li)/mystcraft instability toggle$(li)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$(li)/mystcraft sacrifice <age>$().

These commands act on the current Age unless a specific age argument is provided. They are meant for debugging, curation, server management, and recovering or testing a written Age without hand-editing profile files.
